objects.name: analysis_runs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE analysis_runs ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, baseline_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, baseline_version INTEGER NOT NULL, provider_name VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, production_grade BOOLEAN NOT NULL, input_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, findings JSON NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), FOREIGN KEY(baseline_id) REFERENCES scope_baselines (id) )

objects.name: artifact_links
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE artifact_links ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, artifact_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, requirement_key VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_artifact_links_artifact_key UNIQUE (artifact_id, requirement_key), FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES evidence_artifacts (id), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) )

objects.name: audit_events
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE audit_events ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, event_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, actor_role VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, subject_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, subject_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, detail JSON NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_audit_events_actor_role CHECK (actor_role IN ('SELLER', 'BUYER_EMAIL_VERIFIED', 'SYSTEM')), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) )

objects.name: buyer_decisions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE buyer_decisions ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, request_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, decision VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, buyer_email VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL, statement VARCHAR(500), verification_method VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, change_id VARCHAR(36), artifact_bindings JSON NOT NULL, change_sha256 VARCHAR(64), shares_seller_domain BOOLEAN NOT NULL, verified_at DATETIME NOT NULL, decided_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_buyer_decisions_kind CHECK (kind IN ('SCOPE_CHANGE_APPROVAL', 'DELIVERY_REVIEW')), CONSTRAINT ck_buyer_decisions_decision CHECK (decision IN ('APPROVE_CHANGE', 'REJECT_CHANGE', 'ACKNOWLEDGE_DELIVERY', 'ACCEPT_DELIVERY', 'DISPUTE_DELIVERY')), CONSTRAINT ck_buyer_decisions_method CHECK (verification_method = 'EMAIL_OTP'), UNIQUE (request_id), FOREIGN KEY(request_id) REFERENCES buyer_requests (id), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) )

objects.name: buyer_requests
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE buyer_requests ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, change_id VARCHAR(36), artifact_ids JSON NOT NULL, buyer_email VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL, token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, challenge_hash VARCHAR(64), challenge_expires_at DATETIME, challenge_sends INTEGER NOT NULL, verify_failures INTEGER NOT NULL, verified_at DATETIME, session_hash VARCHAR(64), session_expires_at DATETIME, decided_at DATETIME, version INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_buyer_requests_kind CHECK (kind IN ('SCOPE_CHANGE_APPROVAL', 'DELIVERY_REVIEW')), CONSTRAINT ck_buyer_requests_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'DECIDED', 'CANCELLED')), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), FOREIGN KEY(change_id) REFERENCES scope_changes (id), UNIQUE (token_hash) )

objects.name: deliverables
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE deliverables ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, storage_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (project_id, name, version), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) )

objects.name: delivery_events
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE delivery_events ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, deliverable_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, event_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, actor_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, auth_method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, metadata_json JSON NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_delivery_events_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ('LINK_SENT', 'LINK_ACCESSED', 'FILE_RELEASED', 'BUYER_ACKNOWLEDGED')), FOREIGN KEY(deliverable_id) REFERENCES deliverables (id) )

objects.name: evidence_artifacts
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE evidence_artifacts ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, media_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 VARCHAR(64), content_verification VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, size_bytes INTEGER, content_text TEXT, asserted_at DATETIME, ingested_at DATETIME NOT NULL, supersedes_artifact_id VARCHAR(36), PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_evidence_artifacts_project_name_version UNIQUE (project_id, name, version), CONSTRAINT ck_evidence_artifacts_verification CHECK (content_verification IN ('VERIFIED_SERVER_HASH', 'DECLARED_ONLY', 'UNAVAILABLE')), CONSTRAINT ck_evidence_artifacts_hash_label CHECK ((content_verification = 'UNAVAILABLE') = (sha256 IS NULL)), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), UNIQUE (supersedes_artifact_id), FOREIGN KEY(supersedes_artifact_id) REFERENCES evidence_artifacts (id) )

objects.name: evidence_claims
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE evidence_claims ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, claim TEXT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, source_refs JSON NOT NULL, reviewer_approved BOOLEAN NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_evidence_claims_status CHECK (status IN ('SUPPORTED', 'AMBIGUOUS', 'UNSUPPORTED')), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) )

objects.name: payment_events
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE payment_events ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, payment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, event_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, from_status VARCHAR(40), to_status VARCHAR(40), actor VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, note VARCHAR(255), amount_paid_minor INTEGER, amount_refunded_minor INTEGER, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_events_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ('INVOICE_CREATED', 'INVOICE_SENT', 'STATUS_CHANGED', 'AMOUNTS_UPDATED', 'ANOMALY', 'OPERATION_UNCERTAIN', 'OPERATION_FAILED', 'REVIEW_RESOLVED')), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_events_from_status CHECK (from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ('UNVERIFIED', 'PENDING', 'PARTIALLY_PAID', 'PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED', 'CANCELLED', 'NEEDS_REVIEW')), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_events_to_status CHECK (to_status IS NULL OR to_status IN ('UNVERIFIED', 'PENDING', 'PARTIALLY_PAID', 'PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED', 'CANCELLED', 'NEEDS_REVIEW')), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_events_actor CHECK (actor IN ('SELLER', 'SYSTEM')), FOREIGN KEY(payment_id) REFERENCES payment_records (id), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) )

objects.name: payment_records
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE payment_records ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, provider VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, request_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, recipient_email VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL, invoice_number VARCHAR(64), paypal_invoice_id VARCHAR(100), paypal_transaction_id VARCHAR(100), currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL, amount_paid_minor INTEGER NOT NULL, amount_refunded_minor INTEGER NOT NULL, provider_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, invoice_state VARCHAR(24), operation_state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, operation_started_at DATETIME, replaces_payment_id VARCHAR(36), scope_record_id VARCHAR(36), scope_sha256 VARCHAR(64), checked_at DATETIME, verification_note VARCHAR(255), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_payment_records_project_key UNIQUE (project_id, idempotency_key), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_records_provider CHECK (provider IN ('MOCK_PAYPAL', 'PAYPAL_SANDBOX', 'PAYPAL')), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_records_provider_status CHECK (provider_status IN ('UNVERIFIED', 'PENDING', 'PARTIALLY_PAID', 'PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED', 'CANCELLED', 'NEEDS_REVIEW')), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_records_operation_state CHECK (operation_state IN ('RESERVED', 'CREATING', 'CREATE_UNCERTAIN', 'CREATE_FAILED', 'READY', 'SEND_PENDING', 'SEND_UNCERTAIN')), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_records_invoice_state CHECK (invoice_state IS NULL OR invoice_state IN ('DRAFT', 'SENT', 'SCHEDULED', 'UNPAID', 'PAYMENT_PENDING', 'PARTIALLY_PAID', 'PAID', 'MARKED_AS_PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED', 'MARKED_AS_REFUNDED', 'CANCELLED')), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_records_amount_positive CHECK (amount_minor >= 1), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_records_amounts_nonneg CHECK (amount_paid_minor >= 0 AND amount_refunded_minor >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_records_currency CHECK (length(currency) = 3 AND currency = upper(currency)), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), UNIQUE (invoice_number), UNIQUE (paypal_invoice_id), UNIQUE (paypal_transaction_id), FOREIGN KEY(replaces_payment_id) REFERENCES payment_records (id), FOREIGN KEY(scope_record_id) REFERENCES scope_records (id) )

objects.name: projects
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE projects ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, seller_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_projects_status CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'INVOICED', 'PAID', 'DELIVERED', 'DISPUTED')), FOREIGN KEY(seller_id) REFERENCES sellers (id) )

objects.name: requirements
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE requirements ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, baseline_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, "key" VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, origin VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_requirements_baseline_key UNIQUE (baseline_id, "key"), FOREIGN KEY(baseline_id) REFERENCES scope_baselines (id), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) )

objects.name: scope_baselines
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE scope_baselines ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, source_scope_record_id VARCHAR(36), previous_baseline_id VARCHAR(36), change_id VARCHAR(36), content_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_scope_baselines_project_version UNIQUE (project_id, version), CONSTRAINT ck_scope_baselines_kind CHECK (kind IN ('ORIGINAL', 'AMENDED')), CONSTRAINT ck_scope_baselines_version CHECK (version >= 1), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), FOREIGN KEY(source_scope_record_id) REFERENCES scope_records (id), FOREIGN KEY(previous_baseline_id) REFERENCES scope_baselines (id) )

objects.name: scope_changes
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE scope_changes ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, proposed_requirements JSON NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, base_baseline_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, resolved_baseline_id VARCHAR(36), supersedes_change_id VARCHAR(36), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, resolved_at DATETIME, version INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_scope_changes_status CHECK (status IN ('PROPOSED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'SUPERSEDED')), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), FOREIGN KEY(base_baseline_id) REFERENCES scope_baselines (id), FOREIGN KEY(resolved_baseline_id) REFERENCES scope_baselines (id), FOREIGN KEY(supersedes_change_id) REFERENCES scope_changes (id) )

objects.name: scope_records
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE scope_records ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, source_label VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, source_sha256 VARCHAR(64), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_scope_records_kind CHECK (kind IN ('ORIGINAL', 'CHANGE_REQUEST', 'APPROVAL', 'DELIVERY_NOTE')), FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) )

objects.name: seller_sessions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE seller_sessions ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, seller_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, csrf_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, revoked_at DATETIME, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(seller_id) REFERENCES sellers (id), UNIQUE (token_hash) )

objects.name: sellers
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE sellers ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL, password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (email) )
